correctness.rationale: For conditioned endpoint values u,v>0 on length L, the squared positive standardized mean equals [u²/r+v²/(1-r)−(u−v)²]/L. Minimizing gives r=u/(u+v) and the unique segment optimum Φ(−2√(uv/L)). Hence on a positive first reading, choose the longer conditioned segment; on a nonpositive reading the alarm has already occurred. This gives the stated Gaussian integral and a measurable attaining rule. In the integral, the first marginal depends on s through v_s=1/4−(s−1/2)² while the second term also depends on L_s=1/2+|s−1/2|. Differentiation locally has an integrable Gaussian envelope; only the length term contributes the first-order change. At the midpoint its derivative integrand is (2√(2c)/π)y^(1/2)exp(−2y²−2c²); substituting x=2y² gives Γ(3/4)√c exp(−2c²)/(2^(1/4)π). Reflection gives the opposite left derivative. As s tends to an endpoint, the first reading converges in probability to c>0 and the bounded success integrand tends to Φ(−2c), strictly below the midpoint value. Compactness, the cusp, and reflection then yield mirrored interior maximizers, without uniqueness.
residual_risks: Offline retrospective access, noiseless values, equal strictly positive pinned endpoints, two interior samples, and sampled-value alarm only. No causal monitoring, continuous-minimum accuracy, or uniqueness of the optimal off-center first time follows.

equivalent_formulations.reasoning: Changing the sign maps lower to upper barriers, and normalizing time and diffusion changes only units. Neither operation turns information about the true crossing indicator, or minimum-value error, into the probability of at least one nonpositive sampled value.

value.rationale: A fixed budget of two samples is the first setting where the use of a revealed value can change the next location. The result quantitatively rules out a symmetry-based first-stage design for every positive clearance despite symmetric endpoint data. It supplies the exact conditional policy and local improvement coefficient, not merely a numerical example of an off-center optimum.
residual_risks: The design value is for retrospective sampling; no performance gain for causal monitoring is inferred.
